notes_for_editor: Only one page describes the tower itself (a 2006 sale line); no build year, builder, staffing or buyer found. Height 92 ft is converted to 28.0 m, matching the brief. The 2016 article's list of five Sawyer towers does not name a Winter tower, but it places the Swayne tower between Radisson and Winter, so the story does not link the two. Do not confuse with the WI Historical Society record HI24669, which is the West Fork Lookout Tower (1936, Round Lake, Sawyer County) and is a different tower. No photos found. The 2016 article's Winter Station firefighter says other towers have been dismantled, including one east of the Village of Winter; the article does not name it, so the remark is not tied to this site.
